WPT|/ca.m3d.sub: The component as it is built: reinforcement and formwork, the waterstop in the kicker, the pour of the dosed concrete, curing, the water load in service — and, in X-ray view, the crystals in the pores throughout the concrete and the crack that heals itself. Go through the stages, drag to rotate, zoom in on the details.
WPT|/ca.m3d.caps/0: Reinforcement cage and formwork set, kicker of the earlier pour
WPT|/ca.m3d.caps/1: The crystalline waterstop {CJ5} in the kicker, swelling tape {CJ6} on the working joint, the injection hose {CJ1} as reserve
WPT|/ca.m3d.caps/2: The concrete with BETOCRETE is placed and compacted — dosed at the plant or in the drum of the mixer truck
WPT|/ca.m3d.caps/3: Formwork struck, the concrete kept damp and protected; crystals may appear on the surface
WPT|/ca.m3d.caps/4: Backfilled; the ground water presses against the component — the inside stays dry, vapour still leaves
WPT|/ca.m3d.caps/5: X-ray: crystals grow in the pores throughout the concrete; a later crack of up to 0.4 mm fills with crystals and closes
WPT|/ca.m3d.capsOv/capit/service: Backfilled; the pit stands below the ground water on all sides — dry, the buffers and rails fixed to dry concrete
WPT|/ca.m3d.capsOv/catank/service: Filled: the water stands on the inside — the crystals seal from the inside out, no lining to taint the water or to renew
WPT|/ca.m3d.capsOv/cawall/service: Backfilled with the drainage behind the wall; frost, de-icing salt and spray on the face — the chlorides stay away from the steel
WPT|/ca.m3d.fallback: The 3D view needs WebGL and an internet connection to load. The cross-sections in the section “System” show the same sequence.
WPT|/ca.m3d.co/cabase/0/1: The slab and the walls are cast in the dosed concrete; the construction joint at the kicker is the classic weak point and gets the crystalline waterstop {CJ5}, cast in with the wall. Working joints: swelling tape {CJ6}; critical joints: the injection hose {CJ1} as reserve.
WPT|/ca.m3d.co/cabase/1/0: Dosing where the concrete is made
WPT|/ca.m3d.co/cabase/1/1: Liquid {CL170} or {CL210} is dosed with the mixing water by the dosing system of the plant; powder {CP360} / {CP350} onto the aggregates, mixed 30 seconds before water and cement, then 45 seconds more — or 3 kg water-soluble bags into the drum on site.
WPT|/ca.m3d.co/cabase/2/1: When the ground water rises the capillaries fill, the active ingredient reacts and the pores close; the inside stays dry and vapour permeable. A crack that opens later, up to 0.4 mm, heals itself; no excavation, no membrane to repair.
WPT|/ca.m3d.co/capit/0/0: The deepest point of the building
WPT|/ca.m3d.co/capit/0/1: The lift pit stands below the ground water table on all sides: slab, walls and the kicker joint are cast in the dosed concrete; the waterstop {CJ5} in the kicker, the injection hose {CJ1} as reserve where the pit cannot be reached later.
WPT|/ca.m3d.co/capit/1/1: Where the concrete arrives by truck, {CP360} or {CP350} goes in as 3 kg water-soluble bags: approx. 1 minute of mixing per m³ of drum content, at least 5 minutes. Crack-width limits by the structural engineer; minimum thickness 15 cm.
WPT|/ca.m3d.co/capit/2/1: The pit stays dry from the first day; the buffers, rails and anchors are fixed to dry concrete. A crack from settlement or shrinkage closes itself when water reaches it.
WPT|/ca.m3d.co/catank/0/1: A tank holds water permanently: the dosed concrete seals from the inside out, with {CL170}, {CP360} or {CP350} — tested for drinking water after DVGW W 270 and W 347. {CL210} is used where drinking water is not involved.
WPT|/ca.m3d.co/catank/1/1: The joint between slab and wall gets the crystalline waterstop {CJ5}; inlets and outlets are cast in; the crystalline structure heals the fine cracks that a filled tank always sees.
WPT|/ca.m3d.co/catank/2/0: Vapour permeable, no lining to renew
WPT|/ca.m3d.co/catank/2/1: There is no coating that could taint the water, lift or age; the crystals are part of the concrete. Cracks up to 0.4 mm heal; the pore structure stays dense for the life of the tank.
WPT|/ca.m3d.co/cawall/0/0: Earth on one side, weather on the other
WPT|/ca.m3d.co/cawall/0/1: A retaining wall carries soil and seepage water on its back, frost, de-icing salt and traffic spray on its face. Cast in the dosed concrete, with {CL210} or {CP360} — the hydrophobic sealant lowers the water absorption at once, the crystals follow.
WPT|/ca.m3d.co/cawall/1/1: Reduced chloride ion migration and lower carbonation speed keep the reinforcement passive; the frost and freeze–thaw resistance of the concrete is improved. {CL210} shows the highest effectiveness in exposure class XS.
WPT|/ca.m3d.co/cawall/2/1: No external membrane, no protection boards, no renewal from the soil side: the drainage stays, the wall seals itself and heals its own cracks up to 0.4 mm.
